concepts.def: Order of metals by reactivity: K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al, Zn, Fe, Cu, Ag, Au (most → least).
A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from its compound.
Group 1 metals react vigorously; Mg and below react little or only with steam.
Reactive metals (Mg, Zn) fizz strongly; copper does not react with dilute acid.
Reactive metals tarnish or burn easily; unreactive metals (Au) stay shiny.
Less reactive than carbon: extract by reduction with carbon. More reactive: use electrolysis.
